plugins.name: danger-guard
plugins.description: Before the agent runs a Bash command, blocks the ones that can wreck the machine or the user's data beyond the working repository: recursive deletes of broad places, disk erasure, shutdown, and pkill patterns that would also stop the user's applications

plugins.name: human-edit
plugins.description: human_edit tool: the agent asks the user to edit a file in a tmux split pane and waits until the editor exits

plugins.name: jj
plugins.description: Adds the jj counts (changed files, unpushed commits) and commit and log buttons to the line under the prompt, with a pane for the jj log

plugins.name: next-step
plugins.description: After a turn, shows up to four prompts the user is likely to type next as cards above the prompt: Claude Code's own prompt suggestion first, then more from a fork of the conversation; clicking a card sends it

plugins.name: questions
plugins.description: A list of the decisions the agent made provisionally so work could continue, kept with add_question and shown in a pane for the user to settle by clicking; a question can be talked over with a read-only fork of the conversation first. Adds a pending button to the line under the prompt

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: A list of the pull requests this session created or edited, with CI and review state, shown in a pane; watches CI after a push, tells the agent about merges and CI failures, and adds the PR numbers and a pr button to the line under the prompt

plugins.name: publish-guard
plugins.description: Before the agent pushes from a repository that has scripts/check-public.sh, runs that check and blocks the push when it finds names or keys that must not be published

plugins.name: refs
plugins.description: A list of the documents and URLs this session relied on, kept by the agent with add_reference and shown in a pane; adds a refs button to the line under the prompt

plugins.name: rich
plugins.description: show tool: the agent draws cards, a box-and-arrow diagram, tables and clickable questions inline in the transcript or in a pane

plugins.name: status-band
plugins.description: A line under the prompt that replaces the status line: model, context use and directory. Other mods add their own buttons to its right

plugins.name: devrep
plugins.description: update_devrep tool: while turned on for a session, the agent keeps a short report of where the work stands (doing now, next, and free sections) in a pane, so the user can pick the session back up without reading the transcript
